hero.description: View of a portion of the University of Alabama campus in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, United States. Taken from the the north end zone of Bryant-Denny Stadium. In the foreground are Reese Phifer Hall (far left), Temple Tutwiler Hall (left), and Alpha Omicron Pi (right); at center are Doster Hall and the Rose Administration Building; behind them (center right) are Harris Hall, Adams Hall, and the East Annex; in the background is the wooded portion of The Quad with Denny Chimes.
